snippet.title: I went robot hunting with a bow and arrow
snippet.description:

I can't believe this episode is finally out. We filmed it this summer so it's been a long time coming. Thank you so so so much everybody who helped make this happen! Working together with you is one of the best experiences I've ever had. Also I'm sorry Daryl, your life was short and terrible. I would also like to apologize to the Malaysian Crocodilefish who appears in this episode. I think you are beautiful and one of the finest actors I have ever worked with.
